extracted.intended_audience: prospective students, performers, organizations seeking improvisation/acting/writing training or workshops
extracted.subtask_description: Descriptions and standards for The Second City Training Center programs: courses in improvisation, acting, and writing aimed at developing individual and ensemble artistic voice, practical techniques, and career/transferable-skills outcomes. Also covers faculty availability for workshops and facility use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructor qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Classes, taught by professionals working in their fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page emphasizes instruction by professionals — instructors are active practitioners whose expertise grounds the training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development of artistic voice (individual and ensemble)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dedicated to helping students develop their artistic voice, both individually and within an ensemble.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary pedagogical goal: cultivate each student's personal expression and the ability to function and contribute creatively in ensemble settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of tools and techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the tools and techniques needed to express that voice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training emphasizes practical skills and methodologies that enable students to realize and communicate their artistic ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curriculum grounded in Second City's traditions
rubrics_metrics.description: We draw on Second City's history of ensemble improvisation, satire, and revue comedy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program content is informed by Second City's established forms (ensemble improv, satire, revue) and genre-specific practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Laboratory for innovation and future exploration
rubrics_metrics.description: Serve as a laboratory for the exploration of the future of the art form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond tradition, the centers are positioned to experiment and evolve the art form, encouraging innovation and forward-looking practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alumni outcomes and professional credibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Training Center alumni include Tina Fey, Mike Myers, Chris Farley, Bonnie Hunt, Stephen Colbert, Halle Berry, Sean Hayes, Hinton Battle, and countless other producers, directors, writers and actors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alumni success is presented as an outcome metric indicating the program's effectiveness in preparing students for professional entertainment careers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transferable skills for non-entertainment fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Many of our students pursue professional entertainment careers, yet a large number come from other fields and use the training to improve presentation, creative and team-building skills in a fun and safe environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program is evaluated also by its ability to teach communication, presentation, creativity, and teamwork skills applicable outside show business.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local adaptation and community relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Training Center maintains what is unique to Second City, yet also seeks to serve the needs of its specific community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centers balance organizational identity with local customization to meet community-specific needs and contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty availability for workshops and residencies
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to our regular programs, our faculty is also available to teach one day workshops and short term residencies almost anywhere in the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flexibility and external engagement are part of service offerings — availability for corporate trainings, short courses, or on-site residencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facility availability for meetings, training, rehearsal
rubrics_metrics.description: Need a space for a meeting, training session or rehearsal? Check out The Second City Training Center's new Chicago facility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Physical space and rental availability is an operational criterion relevant to prospective users seeking rehearsal/training venues.
